prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1066; do not mention it.)
text: This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was making a left turn. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. We ask that you provide the policy limits of liability coverage applicable to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page for that policy. We also request that your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident, including photographs, vehicle data, dash camera footage, recorded statements, adjuster notes, repair estimates, and any telematics or event data recorder information. Our client has sustained injuries that require ongoing medical treatment, and we expect that the insurer will treat this preservation request as a priority. Please acknowledge receipt of this letter and confirm in writing that the requested materials are being retained. We look forward to your prompt response so that we can move toward a fair resolution of our client's claim.
